sentences.en: I think speaking as a psychologist, we can be quite good at making the best of the situation we're in and change can be tricky as well.
sentences.zh: 作为一名心理学家，我认为我们很擅长在现有处境中做到最好，而且改变本身也可能很困难。

sentences.en: But it's knowing that you do deserve to have a life that's enjoyable, that feels comfortable, that, you know, it's got good stuff in it and you're allowed.
sentences.zh: 但你要知道，你理应拥有令人愉悦、舒适、充满美好事物的生活，这是被允许的。

sentences.en: You know, I think we spoke briefly last time about money trauma as well, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 记得我们上次简短地谈到了金钱创伤，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, the messages we get given from others around us as we grow up about how how it is if you spend money, you know, you're really decadent or, you know, too carefree or,
sentences.zh: 我们成长过程中从周围人那里接收到的信息，比如如果你花钱，你就是挥霍无度，或者太无忧无虑，或者……

sentences.en: you know, I think I said that my mum always would be an egg sandwich girl because they're the cheapest in the shop, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想我说过，我妈妈总是会买鸡蛋三明治，因为那是店里最便宜的，你知道的。

sentences.en: And anything more more than that is just decadent, you know.
sentences.zh: 除此之外的任何东西都被视为挥霍。

sentences.en: But it's allowing yourself to free yourself from the shackles of what you've been told and actually doing what makes you happy, which can be liberating.
sentences.zh: 但让自己从那些陈旧观念的枷锁中解脱出来，去做真正让你快乐的事，这会是一种解放。

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百同意。

sentences.en: And it's that it's that balance piece again.
sentences.zh: 这又回到了平衡的问题。

sentences.en: And it's a word that I use all of the time.
sentences.zh: 这是我一直挂在嘴边的一个词。

sentences.en: It's that balance of here and now in the future.
sentences.zh: 这就是立足当下与展望未来的平衡。

sentences.en: But one of the things that I kind of hear a lot from clients in the 50s and clients in the 40s is I wish I'd started sooner.
sentences.zh: 但我从四五十岁的客户那里听到最多的一句话就是：我真希望我能早点开始。

sentences.en: I wish I'd taken the stuff a little bit more seriously in my 20s.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我在二十多岁时能更认真地对待这些事。

sentences.en: I'm exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 我和你一模一样。

sentences.en: Been there, done it.
sentences.zh: 我经历过，也做过。

sentences.en: Struggled with young kids.
sentences.zh: 带着年幼的孩子挣扎过。

sentences.en: Couldn't make ends meet at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 月底入不敷出。

sentences.en: Kind of stuff on credit cards.
sentences.zh: 靠信用卡度日。

sentences.en: Well, been there and done it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我都经历过。

sentences.en: I've kind of made every possible financial mistake you could have possibly made.
sentences.zh: 我几乎犯过所有可能犯的财务错误。

sentences.en: But overall, I wish I'd been more financially literate when I was in my 20s and knew about this stuff.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，我真希望我在二十多岁时就有更多的理财知识，了解这些事情。

sentences.en: And I think we've got a generation of kind of people kind of growing up through the through the workplace and certainly our kids where all of this information is available.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们这一代人在职场中成长，当然还有我们的孩子，现在所有这些信息都是触手可及的。

sentences.en: And that's a good and a positive thing because it could be information overload.
sentences.zh: 这是一件好事，也是积极的一面，因为信息过载也可能成为问题。

sentences.en: You just feel like you can't move because there's so much information out there.
sentences.zh: 你可能会因为信息太多而感到寸步难行。

sentences.en: And let's be honest, a lot of the stuff that you see on kind of social media can be rubbish at times.
sentences.zh: 老实说，你在社交媒体上看到的很多东西有时都是垃圾。

sentences.en: I think it's about being selective about the information that you think would be relevant and work towards and help you along those goals.
sentences.zh: 我认为关键在于要有选择性地获取那些你认为相关的信息，并朝着目标努力，帮助你实现这些目标。

sentences.en: Like to be successful, you don't need to have five Lamborghinis part in your drive and live in a $25 million house in L.A.
sentences.zh: 想要成功，你不需要在车道上停五辆兰博基尼，也不需要住在洛杉矶价值2500万美元的豪宅里。

sentences.en: You know, define what your definition of success is right now.
sentences.zh: 现在就定义一下你心目中的成功是什么。

sentences.en: And that might just be getting to the end of the month and having £10 a month to be able to put aside and think,
sentences.zh: 那可能只是月底能省下10英镑，然后心想：

sentences.en: I've started my financial journey.
sentences.zh: 我已经开启了我的财务之旅。

sentences.en: I've started my savings.
sentences.zh: 我已经开始储蓄了。

sentences.en: That to me is massive.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这意义重大。

sentences.en: That's much more valuable than the guy who can put 20 grand a month away because you've got started.
sentences.zh: 这比那个每月能存两万英镑的人更有价值，因为你已经开始了。

sentences.en: You've started that journey and that should be applauded and should be loaded because it's incredibly important because that's the first step.
sentences.zh: 你已经踏上了那段旅程，这应该受到赞赏和鼓励，因为它极其重要，这是第一步。

sentences.en: And after that comes the second step.
sentences.zh: 在那之后是第二步。

sentences.en: After that comes the third one.
sentences.zh: 接着是第三步。

sentences.en: And then it just becomes routine over a period of time.
sentences.zh: 久而久之，它就成了习惯。

sentences.en: And it's the phrase of whenever you get a new car, if you buy a new VW Golf, you'll see them everywhere.
sentences.zh: 就像那句话说的，当你买了一辆新大众高尔夫，你会发现到处都是它。

sentences.en: Everybody's got a VW Golf.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有一辆大众高尔夫。

sentences.en: They haven't got a new VW Golf.
sentences.zh: 其实他们并没有买新车。

sentences.en: You're just more aware of it.
sentences.zh: 只是你对此更关注了。

sentences.en: But when you start being more aware with your finances, then all of a sudden, when you could just afford to do £10 a month,
sentences.zh: 当你开始更关注自己的财务状况时，突然之间，当你只能负担每月10英镑时，

sentences.en: then next month, all of a sudden, you can probably do £20.
sentences.zh: 下个月，你可能就能存20英镑了。

sentences.en: Because you're a little bit more aware of what the goal is in the five years and what impact a £10 or £20 a month can make.
sentences.zh: 因为你更清楚五年后的目标是什么，也更清楚每月10或20英镑能产生什么影响。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, it's £30, £40, £50.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，变成了30、40、50英镑。

sentences.en: Get a pay rise.
sentences.zh: 加薪了。

sentences.en: Maybe you get some extra money coming in.
sentences.zh: 也许有额外的收入进来。

sentences.en: And maybe you reduce your costs.
sentences.zh: 也许你减少了开支。

sentences.en: And it just starts to gather some traction.
sentences.zh: 一切就开始步入正轨了。

sentences.en: If you can grasp that, it sets you up for life rather than get into 40s and 50s and saying, I wish I'd started sooner.
sentences.zh: 如果你能领悟这一点，它将让你受益终生，而不是等到四五十岁时才说：我真希望我能早点开始。

sentences.en: And I do wish I'd started sooner.
sentences.zh: 我确实希望我能早点开始。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: We hear that all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们经常听到这样的话。

sentences.en: So, yeah, the people listening now that are in their early 20s, start now.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在正在听节目的二十出头的年轻人，现在就开始吧。

sentences.en: Start now.
sentences.zh: 现在就开始。

sentences.en: And I think it's that.
sentences.zh: 我想就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: I felt silly, Ian.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得很傻，伊恩。

sentences.en: I felt silly because I didn't even have a boyfriend, a long-term partner at that time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很傻，因为那时我甚至连男朋友都没有，也没有长期伴侣。

sentences.en: I felt like, oh, just little old me.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得，噢，就我这小人物。

sentences.en: Like, oh, it's a bit embarrassing, a bit cringe, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 就像，噢，这有点尴尬，有点让人难为情，不是吗？

sentences.en: All this pension and investing.
sentences.zh: 搞什么养老金和投资。

sentences.en: It's not silly, though, is it?
sentences.zh: 但这并不傻，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 并不傻。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不。

sentences.en: Like, that's the stuff that over the years, like I said earlier, the people that have got that financial security in the 40s and 50s are the ones I start now.
sentences.zh: 就像我之前说的，那些在四五十岁时拥有财务安全感的人，都是从现在开始的。

sentences.en: It's the ones that started in the 20s and start taking this stuff a little bit seriously.
sentences.zh: 是那些在二十多岁就开始认真对待这些事情的人。

sentences.en: And you've got to start somewhere with, like, the 10 of the 25 quid or whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 你必须从某个地方开始，哪怕是10英镑或25英镑，无论多少。

sentences.en: It's not cringe.
sentences.zh: 这并不丢人。

sentences.en: It's not silly.
sentences.zh: 这并不傻。

sentences.en: You might think it's boring.
sentences.zh: 你可能觉得这很无聊。

sentences.en: But I tell you what's not boring, retiring at 55 when everyone else is out working.
sentences.zh: 但我告诉你什么不无聊：当别人还在辛苦工作时，你在55岁退休。

sentences.en: Like,
sentences.zh: 就像，

sentences.en: with all those people that are kind of taking the mick out of you because you put your money at your pension when you're in your 20s and they're still slogging away in the 50s and 60s.
sentences.zh: 那些曾经嘲笑你二十多岁就往养老金里存钱的人，到了五六十岁还在辛苦奔波。

sentences.en: And you're kind of sat on a beach for six months of the year.
sentences.zh: 而你却一年有六个月坐在沙滩上。

sentences.en: That's not boring.
sentences.zh: 那一点也不无聊。

sentences.en: And that's the reality of it, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是现实，对吧？

sentences.en: I've had clients over the years and have taken to the other extreme.
sentences.zh: 这些年来，我遇到过走极端路线的客户。

sentences.en: And I'll use one example.
sentences.zh: 我举个例子。

sentences.en: There was a guy that I gave mortgage advice to a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 很久以前，我给一个家伙提供过抵押贷款建议。

sentences.en: And he's 25, full-time plumber, ran his own business, lived at home with his dad, never spent any money, had 250 grand in the bank at 25.
sentences.zh: 他25岁，全职水管工，经营自己的生意，和父亲住在一起，从不乱花钱，25岁时银行里就有25万英镑。

sentences.en: And I'm like, wow, that's incredible.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哇，这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: What are you going to do with that?
sentences.zh: 你打算用这些钱做什么？

sentences.en: He says, well, I want to get it at 400 and then I want to buy a house.
sentences.zh: 他说，我想存到40万，然后买套房子。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: What do you want to buy a house for?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要买房子？

sentences.en: Because I've got security for me.
sentences.zh: 因为这能给我安全感。

sentences.en: Family, amazing.
sentences.zh: 为了家庭，太棒了。

sentences.en: How many days a week do you work?
sentences.zh: 你一周工作几天？

sentences.en: Seven days a week.
sentences.zh: 一周七天。

sentences.en: Do you have any time off?
sentences.zh: 你有休息时间吗？

sentences.en: No, never go on holiday.
sentences.zh: 没有，从不去度假。

sentences.en: And I work 12-hour days.
sentences.zh: 我每天工作12个小时。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: So you're going to have this big 400 grand house, four bedrooms and all the rest of it just for you.
sentences.zh: 所以你打算买一栋价值40万英镑的大房子，有四个卧室，所有这些都只是为了你自己。

sentences.en: And he's like, well, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 他问，你什么意思？

sentences.en: I said, well, how are you going to meet somebody if you do that?
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你这样做，你打算怎么去认识另一半呢？

sentences.en: And the penny just dropped all of a sudden.
sentences.zh: 他突然恍然大悟。

sentences.en: He was like, yeah, you're right.
sentences.zh: 他说，是的，你是对的。

sentences.en: Because he's been so focused on earning that money.
sentences.zh: 因为他太专注于赚钱了。

sentences.en: He's just forgotten about everything else in his life.
sentences.zh: 他忘记了生活中其他的一切。

sentences.en: So that's the far extreme of it.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是极端的例子。

sentences.en: And somewhere in the middle is the right balance.
sentences.zh: 而中间的某个位置才是正确的平衡。

sentences.en: Doesn't mean you kind of follow that route if you want to, fine.
sentences.zh: 并不是说你不能走那条路，如果你想走，没问题。

sentences.en: But it's that here and now.
sentences.zh: 但关键在于立足当下。

sentences.en: But just getting started with one eye just in the future of where you want to get to.
sentences.zh: 同时保持一只眼睛盯着未来，看看你想达到什么目标。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I know that when you're saving for a pension, when it gets taken out of your account or taken out of your wages, it gets taken off pre-tax, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 我知道当你为养老金储蓄时，当钱从你的账户或工资中扣除时，它是税前扣除的，对吧？

sentences.en: But when it comes back to you again, it does then get taxed if you're earning over the taxable threshold.
sentences.zh: 但当它回到你手中时，如果你的收入超过了应纳税起征点，它确实会被征税。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 对吗？

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You're learning.
sentences.zh: 你正在学习中。

sentences.en: Well done.
sentences.zh: 干得好。

sentences.en: So you do.
sentences.zh: 你确实是这样。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: So I suppose the difference is you've got control over how you take that income.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为区别在于，你可以掌控自己获取那笔收入的方式。

sentences.en: So, yes, the money that you go and you're going to save tax, but you're paid on the back end.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，你存下的钱确实能省税，但你是到后期才拿到这笔钱的。

sentences.en: But that money that you're saving tax now is a basic rate taxpayer.
sentences.zh: 但你现在省下的那部分税款，是基于基本税率纳税人的标准。

sentences.en: You put your pension contribution in, it will get rounded up by an additional 20% so you get tax relief.
sentences.zh: 当你存入养老金时，它会额外增加20%，这样你就获得了税收减免。

sentences.en: Higher rate tax, that's 40%.
sentences.zh: 更高税率的话，那就是40%。

sentences.en: If you do that out of your business and your corporation tax rate, depending on what your turnover is, your business can contribute to your pension.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过企业来做这件事，根据你的营业额，你的企业可以为你的养老金缴费，这取决于你的企业所得税率。

sentences.en: Now, fast forward to 30, 40 years down the line, you've got this great big pension pot that you want to start taking some money from.
sentences.zh: 现在，快进到30、40年后，你拥有了一大笔养老金，想要开始从中取钱了。

sentences.en: If you've got other assets, maybe property, savings, investments, or whatever it is, you can control to a certain extent how you take that income.
sentences.zh: 如果你还有其他资产，比如房产、储蓄、投资或其他什么，你可以在一定程度上控制获取收入的方式。

sentences.en: You might decide that you're taking income out of your investments and they might be tax-free if you've got them as ISAs.
sentences.zh: 你可能会决定从投资中提取收入，如果这些投资是个人储蓄账户（ISA），那它们可能就是免税的。

sentences.en: So you can take up to higher rate tax out of that pot.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以从那笔资金中提取达到高税率水平的金额。

sentences.en: You've got a lot more flexibility on that.
sentences.zh: 在这方面你有更大的灵活性。

sentences.en: Yes, do you know what?
sentences.zh: 是啊，你知道吗？

sentences.en: You've got to pay some tax on it at some point, potentially.
sentences.zh: 在某个阶段，你可能还是得为此缴纳一些税款。

sentences.en: But as I said at the start, if you don't spend it, that could go to your kids, that could go to your partner, that could be various other ways.
sentences.zh: 但正如我开头所说，如果你没花掉它，它还可以留给你的孩子、伴侣，或者通过其他各种方式处理。

sentences.en: If you want to get really technical, sometimes you can borrow against the pension to do things.
sentences.zh: 如果你想深入探讨技术细节，有时你甚至可以用养老金作为抵押来做一些事情。

sentences.en: If you've got your own business, tax is one of those things that you can't really avoid.
sentences.zh: 如果你有自己的企业，税收是你无法真正避免的事情之一。

sentences.en: It's that old thing I just said, the one thing that you can't avoid is debt and taxes.
sentences.zh: 就像我刚才说的老话，唯一无法避免的就是死亡和税收。

sentences.en: It happens to all of us.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都难免遇到。

sentences.en: But you can have control over the level of tax you pay in your retirement much more than you can when you're employed or when you're necessarily building a business.
sentences.zh: 但相比于受雇工作或创业初期，你在退休时对所缴税款水平的掌控力要大得多。

sentences.en: Plus, you also get 25% tax-free.
sentences.zh: 另外，你还能获得25%的免税额。

sentences.en: You can take out of your pension as a lump sum anyway.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，你可以一次性从养老金中取出这笔钱。

sentences.en: That might be enough to keep you taken over for four or five years or to pay the mortgage off or have the round-the-world trip.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱可能足够维持你四五年的生活，或者用来还清抵押贷款，又或者去环游世界。

sentences.en: Pensions are very tax-efficient when you go in.
sentences.zh: 养老金在存入时是非常节税的。

sentences.en: They can be just as tax-efficient on the way out if you manage them properly.
sentences.zh: 如果你管理得当，在取出时也可以同样节税。

sentences.en: Ah, so that's when you hear people retiring and they say, oh, I've got a lump sum and my pension.
sentences.zh: 啊，所以这就是为什么常听人说退休时，哦，我有一笔养老金的一次性提款。

sentences.en: And that's what you mean.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: And it can make a big difference.
sentences.zh: 这会产生很大的影响。

sentences.en: And a lot of people just kind of almost sleepwalk into retirement without really reviewing this stuff until you get to the back end of it.
sentences.zh: 很多人几乎是浑浑噩噩地步入退休生活，直到最后阶段才真正去审视这些问题。

sentences.en: Oh, my God, what am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 天哪，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: Well, if you wait until three weeks before you retire to look at this stuff, it's too late.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你等到退休前三周才去考虑这些，那就太晚了。

sentences.en: You need to be looking at this consistently on the run-up there to know whether you're on track, off track, what you can do.
sentences.zh: 你需要在此之前的这段时间里持续关注，以了解自己是否在正轨上，是否偏离了目标，以及你能做些什么。

sentences.en: Do you need to kick up the backside to put more money in?
sentences.zh: 你需要督促自己投入更多的钱吗？

sentences.en: Have you got enough?
sentences.zh: 你存够了吗？

sentences.en: Are there other things that you could be doing?
sentences.zh: 还有其他你能做的事情吗？

sentences.en: I think I'm a big believer in having as many different things pushing in that direction as possible.
sentences.zh: 我非常相信尽可能多地让不同的事物朝着同一个方向推进。

sentences.en: It's not just your pension.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是你的养老金。

sentences.en: That could be your business.
sentences.zh: 那可以是你的生意。

sentences.en: That could be your property.
sentences.zh: 那可以是你的房产。

sentences.en: That could be your savings, your investments.
sentences.zh: 那可以是你的储蓄、你的投资。

sentences.en: That could be other things that you're involved in.
sentences.zh: 那还可以是你参与的其他事情。

sentences.en: The more you've got pushing that way, the more security you've got that you're going to hit that end goal at the back end.
sentences.zh: 你朝着这个方向投入的越多，你最终实现目标的保障就越大。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I guess I'm part of the kind of spread your risk kind of philosophy.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想我也属于那种分散风险的哲学派。

sentences.en: So because I'm self-employed, I only pay my tax twice a year and I don't trust myself not to spend it.
sentences.zh: 因为我是自雇人士，我一年只交两次税，而且我不信任自己，怕把钱花掉。

sentences.en: And so I save that by putting that up into premium bonds, which is kind of guaranteed, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以我通过把钱存入溢价债券（Premium Bonds）来储蓄，这算是有保障的，对吧？

sentences.en: It's, you know, you can do up to 50 grand a year and that money is safe as housing because that's with the government.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你一年最多可以存5万英镑，而且这笔钱非常安全，因为它是政府担保的。

sentences.en: But actually, you can earn money on that.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，你还能从中赚到钱。

sentences.en: You win money.
sentences.zh: 你会赢得奖金。

sentences.en: But then you can earn money on the money that's invested again.
sentences.zh: 而且你还可以从再次投资的钱中赚取收益。

sentences.en: So that becomes compound in itself, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这本身就形成了复利。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And it makes a big difference long term, plus the tax relief and everything else that comes with it.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，这会产生很大的影响，再加上税收减免以及随之而来的一切。

sentences.en: It's huge.
sentences.zh: 影响非常巨大。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And my dad, when he passed away, he left my boys a small amount of money and I decided to put that into premium bonds for them.
sentences.zh: 我父亲去世时，留给我儿子们一小笔钱，我决定把这笔钱存入溢价债券。

sentences.en: And the other day, my youngest came home and on the sofa was a letter from them saying he'd won £150.
sentences.zh: 前几天，我小儿子回家时，沙发上有一封来自那里的信，说他赢了150英镑。

sentences.en: And like, you know, it's amazing, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，这很神奇，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because actually, there's not a huge amount in there, but that's what he'd won.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，里面的钱并不多，但他确实赢了。

sentences.en: And, you know, he's like, oh, amazing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他当时说，哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: What can I buy with that?
sentences.zh: 我能用它买什么？

sentences.en: And then I'm like, well, nothing.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，嗯，什么都买不了。

sentences.en: We're going to leave it in there and see what that happens for your future.
sentences.zh: 我们要把它留在里面，看看它对你的未来会有什么影响。

sentences.en: But already the boys are like, oh, that means I've got more than you now because I've won, you know.
sentences.zh: 但孩子们已经开始说，哦，那意味着我现在比你有钱了，因为我赢了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And it's, you know, it's, yeah, it's safe to have conversations with our children about money, isn't it, as well?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，和我们的孩子谈论金钱是件很安全的事，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's so important.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。

sentences.en: I mean, you know better than anybody else, like,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你比任何人都清楚，比如，

sentences.en: at what age kids' cognitive behaviour is set by and what an influence we have on our kids' behaviours and how they manage their behaviour.
sentences.zh: 孩子们的认知行为在什么年龄定型，以及我们对孩子们的行为和他们如何管理自己的行为有多大的影响。

sentences.en: But importantly, how they manage their money because they learn from us all of the time.
sentences.zh: 但重要的是，他们如何管理自己的钱，因为他们一直在向我们学习。

sentences.en: And us modelling certain kinds of behaviour has such a positive impact on the kids.
sentences.zh: 我们示范某种行为对孩子们有非常积极的影响。

sentences.en: And it's exactly the same the other way around.
sentences.zh: 反过来也是完全一样的。

sentences.en: Like, if we are spending money willy-nilly and quite freely on all kinds of stuff, then your kids are going to grow up in that environment of thinking that that's acceptable.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我们随意地挥霍金钱，那么你的孩子就会在那种环境中成长，认为那是可以接受的。

sentences.en: If you're in mountains of debt, then they're probably going to follow the same route.
sentences.zh: 如果你债台高筑，那么他们很可能会走上同样的道路。

sentences.en: It's very difficult for them to break out of it.
sentences.zh: 他们很难摆脱这种模式。

sentences.en: So, as much as managing your own money is important, just remember you're setting examples for your kids and how they manage theirs as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，管理好自己的钱固然重要，但要记住，你也在为孩子们树立榜样，影响他们如何管理自己的钱。

sentences.en: Getting them involved in those conversations as early as possible makes such a difference.
sentences.zh: 让他们尽早参与到这些对话中来，会产生很大的不同。

sentences.en: And it doesn't necessarily have to start with things like pocket money.
sentences.zh: 而且这不一定非要从零花钱之类的事情开始。

sentences.en: It could be, you just talk to them about managing the money and managing a savings account or how you pay your bills every month or what a mortgage is, what rent is,
sentences.zh: 你可以只是和他们谈论如何管理金钱、管理储蓄账户，或者你每个月如何支付账单，什么是抵押贷款，什么是租金，

sentences.en: what council tax is.
sentences.zh: 什么是市政税。

sentences.en: Having those conversations and keeping them open.
sentences.zh: 进行这些对话并保持开放的态度。

sentences.en: I think the education system's got a long way to go to kind of have those conversations as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为教育系统在进行这些对话方面还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: There are some incredible things happening in the background.
sentences.zh: 在幕后确实发生了一些令人难以置信的事情。

sentences.en: There are lots of startup foundations.
sentences.zh: 有很多初创基金会。

sentences.en: I'm involved with one of them that will go into schools and talk to them about financial education and what a mortgage is, what a savings account is, what A, B, C, D is.
sentences.zh: 我参与了其中一个，他们会走进学校，和孩子们谈论金融教育，什么是抵押贷款，什么是储蓄账户，什么是A、B、C、D。

sentences.en: And just really distilled out of simple forms because, again, as parents, not everybody knows this stuff.
sentences.zh: 并且真正以简单的形式提炼出来，因为同样地，作为父母，并不是每个人都懂这些。

sentences.en: Not everybody knows what a mortgage is, how that works, and what an investment is, and what a stock or a share is.
sentences.zh: 并不是每个人都知道什么是抵押贷款，它是如何运作的，什么是投资，什么是股票或份额。

sentences.en: But by having those conversations, we're just equipping our children a lot better.
sentences.zh: 但通过这些对话，我们只是让我们的孩子准备得更好。

sentences.en: And they're also going to be able to cut through the noise and see through the BS because there's a lot of it out there on social media.
sentences.zh: 他们也将能够过滤掉噪音，看穿那些胡言乱语，因为社交媒体上有很多这样的东西。

sentences.en: And they've grown up in a generation of where, as I said earlier, unless you're Jake Paul and driving a Lamborghini, then that's not classed as success.
sentences.zh: 他们成长在这样一代人中，正如我之前所说，除非你是杰克·保罗（Jake Paul）并开着兰博基尼，否则那就不被视为成功。

sentences.en: That's not success.
sentences.zh: 那不是成功。

sentences.en: That's just, I mean, I'm sure the guys worked incredibly hard to get there, but that doesn't mean if you don't hit that level that you failed at all.
sentences.zh: 那只是，我的意思是，我相信那些人为了达到那个目标付出了难以置信的努力，但这并不意味着如果你没有达到那个水平，你就彻底失败了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 是的，我明白你的意思。

sentences.en: My kids both want to be either premiership footballers or YouTubers and have seven cars in the garage.
sentences.zh: 我的两个孩子都想成为英超足球运动员或YouTuber，并在车库里放七辆车。

sentences.en: And it's like, oh, baby boys, like, you know, mummy's got a 10-year-old Peugeot and she's actually a really nice person and works really hard.
sentences.zh: 然后我就说，哦，宝贝们，你知道，妈妈有一辆开了10年的标致，但她其实是一个非常好的人，工作也非常努力。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's still really incredibly important.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那仍然是非常非常重要的。

sentences.en: But it's almost like go big or go home.
sentences.zh: 但他们几乎就是那种要么做大，要么回家（不成功便成仁）的心态。

sentences.en: Like they're not, they can't, they can't see anything else as being viable.
sentences.zh: 就像他们无法，他们无法看到其他任何可行的选择。

sentences.en: I had the same with my two.
sentences.zh: 我的两个孩子也一样。

sentences.en: They both want to be professional footballers.
sentences.zh: 他们都想成为职业足球运动员。

sentences.en: Both played football to a high enough standard.
sentences.zh: 两人踢球的水平都足够高。

sentences.en: But once they started getting to a certain standard and they realized the level of commitment involved, neither of them wanted to do that anymore.
sentences.zh: 但一旦他们达到了一定水平，意识到其中涉及的投入程度时，他们都不想再那样做了。

sentences.en: It just kind of felt like it was going to overtake their life to get there.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像为了达到那个目标，生活会被完全占据。

sentences.en: And ultimately, that's a great point because if you want to get to that YouTube level of stardom,
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这是一个很好的观点，因为如果你想达到YouTube那种明星水平，

sentences.en: you want to get to that professional sports level of stardom or CEO of like a worldwide company, it's got to take over your life.
sentences.zh: 你想达到职业体育明星水平，或者成为全球性公司的CEO，这必须占据你的生活。

sentences.en: It's got to be a big life commitment.
sentences.zh: 这必须是一项巨大的生活投入。

sentences.en: And I kind of had that realization a while back that I could have all that stuff if I really wanted it, but do I really want it?
sentences.zh: 我前段时间意识到，如果我真的想要，我可以拥有所有这些东西，但我真的想要吗？

sentences.en: And it's that old adage of, do you want to be a millionaire?
sentences.zh: 这就是那句老话，你想成为百万富翁吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to spend a million pounds?
sentences.zh: 你想花掉一百万英镑吗？

sentences.en: And I think the vast majority of people would like to spend a million pounds, but they don't necessarily want to be a millionaire because to get to a millionaire,
sentences.zh: 我认为绝大多数人想花掉一百万英镑，但他们不一定想成为百万富翁，因为要成为百万富翁，

sentences.en: there's a lot of graft, work, blood, sweat, and tears to get there.
sentences.zh: 需要付出大量的苦干、工作、血汗和泪水才能达到。

sentences.en: And I think that's missing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一点被忽略了。

sentences.en: But I think as kids kind of grow older, they start to realize that level of commitment it takes to get to that point.
sentences.zh: 但我认为随着孩子们长大，他们开始意识到达到那个点所需的投入程度。

sentences.en: And I think the people listening to this podcast will absolutely resonate with what you've said about the hard graft
sentences.zh: 而且我认为听这个播客的人绝对会和你所说的关于艰苦奋斗的内容产生共鸣，

sentences.en: because what you may not realize is that it's really, really, really hard to become a professionally qualified psychologist as well.
sentences.zh: 因为你可能没有意识到，成为一名专业合格的心理学家也非常非常非常困难。

sentences.en: It's so competitive that lots of people do, like you say, just give up or decide that, you know,
sentences.zh: 竞争太激烈了，很多人就像你说的，只是放弃了，或者决定，你知道，

sentences.en: they're going to do something different instead because it's, you know, there's so much rejection,
sentences.zh: 他们去做别的事情，因为，你知道，有太多的拒绝，

sentences.en: there's so much, you know, uncertainty that the people that you then do see as qualified psychologists
sentences.zh: 有太多的不确定性，所以你看到的那些合格的心理学家，

sentences.en: have absolutely, you know, put in that graft and the perseverance and taken the knockbacks and the setbacks and the kind of not knowing whether the prize will ever come.
sentences.zh: 绝对是付出了那种努力和毅力，承受了挫折和打击，以及那种不知道回报是否会到来的不确定性。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, it's, I think people will absolutely resonate with what you've said,
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以是的，我想人们绝对会和你所说的产生共鸣，

sentences.en: but it also hopefully means they're going to go the hard graft to, to really make their savings become their wealth, you know, and make that work for themselves too.
sentences.zh: 但也希望这意味着他们会去努力奋斗，真正让他们的储蓄变成财富，你知道，并让它为自己所用。

sentences.en: And it's almost, it takes some of the pressure off by doing that.
sentences.zh: 而且这样做几乎减轻了一些压力。

sentences.en: Like I get the hard graft, you've got to put those hard yards in earlier on in your career,
sentences.zh: 就像我理解艰苦奋斗，你必须在职业生涯早期付出那些艰苦的努力，

sentences.en: but if you can get the finances and get on top of those, it means that further down the line,
sentences.zh: 但如果你能搞定财务并掌控它们，这意味着在未来，

sentences.en: you don't have to put that graft in anymore because you've got that security blanket of knowing,
sentences.zh: 你就不必再那样辛苦了，因为你有了安全保障，知道，

sentences.en: I'm financially secure, I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 我在财务上是安全的，我没问题。

sentences.en: And that's an incredible place to be in.
sentences.zh: 那是一个令人难以置信的境界。

sentences.en: And the difference you can see in people when they get to that point is,
sentences.zh: 当你看到人们达到那个点时，那种差异是，

sentences.en: it was life changing.
sentences.zh: 那是改变生活的。

sentences.en: Not everyone will get there though.
sentences.zh: 不过并不是每个人都能达到。

sentences.en: And I also understand that.
sentences.zh: 我也理解这一点。

sentences.en: I don't mean that everybody has to get there because everybody's got their own different version of freedom and what their life wants to look like.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说每个人都必须达到那个点，因为每个人对自由的定义以及他们想要的生活方式都有所不同。

sentences.en: It's not for me to dictate which, which way is right and which way is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我不应该去评判哪种方式是对的，哪种方式是错的。

sentences.en: But certainly in the world that I operate in, that financial security piece is really important.
sentences.zh: 但肯定在我所处的领域，财务安全这一块非常重要。

sentences.en: It makes such a difference.
sentences.zh: 它确实带来了很大的不同。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And before we hit record, you and I were talking about strategy in business.
sentences.zh: 在我们开始录音之前，你和我谈到了商业战略。

sentences.en: But the same is true in employed life as well.
sentences.zh: 但同样的情况也适用于受雇生活。

sentences.en: You know, you're allowed to have a strategy for your life and that can change over time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以为你的生活制定战略，而且这可以随着时间的推移而改变。

sentences.en: It can change as regularly as you need, but it just makes us a bit less aimless is the hope, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 它可以根据你的需要随时改变，但希望这能让我们少一点漫无目的，不是吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And over the years, I'm sure we've both worked with people that have had one job for one company for the rest, for all of their lives.
sentences.zh: 而且多年来，我相信我们都曾与那些一生只为一家公司工作的人共事过。

sentences.en: And like, that wasn't for me, but that was perfect for them.
sentences.zh: 而且，那并不适合我，但对他们来说却很完美。

sentences.en: That was perfect for them.
sentences.zh: 那对他们来说很完美。

sentences.en: And they've got to the end of their life, end of their kind of working life and thought, great, I've spent 30 years with one company and that's been enough for me and happy days.
sentences.zh: 他们走到了人生的尽头，职业生涯的尽头，心想：太好了，我在一家公司待了30年，这对我来说已经足够了，日子过得很开心。

sentences.en: I'm happy.
sentences.zh: 我很幸福。

sentences.en: Like, that's why life's so great because there are so many different options about what you can do
sentences.zh: 所以说，生活之所以如此美好，是因为关于你能做什么，有太多不同的选择，

sentences.en: and what that means for you in terms of your happiness, your well-being, your financial status, your financial security, all of those things.
sentences.zh: 以及这些选择对你的幸福感、健康、财务状况、财务安全等各方面意味着什么。

sentences.en: There's so many moving parts and so many different avenues you can take.
sentences.zh: 生活中有很多变数，也有很多不同的道路可以选择。

sentences.en: And you can always reinvent the wheel and kind of go down a different route and try something else.
sentences.zh: 你总能推陈出新，换条路走，尝试点别的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Honestly, Ian, I think we will have to invite you back for another money clinic because there's just so many questions and so many, it's just, you make everything so accessible
sentences.zh: 说实话，Ian，我想我们还得再邀请你来做一次理财诊所，因为问题实在太多了，而且你把一切都讲得那么通俗易懂，

sentences.en: and so easy to understand.
sentences.zh: 非常容易理解。

sentences.en: So thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: How can people learn more about you and your work?
sentences.zh: 人们怎样才能更多地了解你和你的工作呢？

sentences.en: Because they will want to, I know.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道他们会想了解的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Really, really simple.
sentences.zh: 真的非常简单。

sentences.en: I am on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我在领英（LinkedIn）上。

sentences.en: So if you just search for Ian Dempsey on LinkedIn, I haven't got a website yet.
sentences.zh: 所以你只要在领英上搜索Ian Dempsey就行，我还没做网站。

sentences.en: That's, as we're talking about strategy and business, that's job number 345 on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 正如我们谈论战略和商业时所说，那是待办事项清单上的第345项工作。

sentences.en: That's going to come eventually, but I'm on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 以后会有的，但我现在在领英上。

sentences.en: I share lots of information about budget and finances, money.
sentences.zh: 我分享了很多关于预算、财务和金钱的信息。

sentences.en: I'm a big believer in education, all the stuff I've talked about today.
sentences.zh: 我非常相信教育，也就是我今天谈到的所有内容。

sentences.en: Most of that was probably kind of in post from LinkedIn anyway.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分内容可能都是我从领英上发布的内容里整理出来的。

sentences.en: Follow me along.
sentences.zh: 关注我吧。

sentences.en: Ask me any questions that you've got.
sentences.zh: 有什么问题尽管问我。

sentences.en: I'll share as much information as I can.
sentences.zh: 我会尽可能多地分享信息。

sentences.en: Kind of demystify the smoke and mirrors of finances.
sentences.zh: 帮你揭开财务领域那些故弄玄虚的迷雾。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And I think what I might do, Ian, is I might schedule this for January because that feels like kind of an optimistic time.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能会把这一期安排在1月份，因为那感觉是一个充满希望的时刻。

sentences.en: What's your top tip for making 2024 your, you know, your wealthiest, most productive year yet for your money?
sentences.zh: 你有什么秘诀能让2024年成为大家在金钱方面最富有、最高产的一年吗？

sentences.en: We could do a whole episode on that.
sentences.zh: 我们可以专门做一期节目来谈这个。

sentences.en: I think it's been really, try and be really clear about what you want.
sentences.zh: 我认为最重要的是，试着明确自己到底想要什么。

sentences.en: And there's some questions that I always ask my clients, like, what do you want out of this process?
sentences.zh: 我总是问客户一些问题，比如：你希望从这个过程中得到什么？

sentences.en: So I'm sat down with a client and they're talking about financial advice on money.
sentences.zh: 比如我正坐下来和一位客户谈论理财建议。

sentences.en: What do you want out of the process?
sentences.zh: 你希望从这个过程中得到什么？

sentences.en: So if you're going to get on top of your finances, like, why?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想理清自己的财务状况，问问自己：为什么？

sentences.en: Why is that important to you?
sentences.zh: 为什么这对你很重要？

sentences.en: What do you want to achieve by doing it?
sentences.zh: 你想通过这样做实现什么目标？

sentences.en: Why is that important to you?
sentences.zh: 为什么这对你很重要？

sentences.en: And how are you going to feel when you get there?
sentences.zh: 当你达到目标时，你会有什么感觉？

sentences.en: And I think if you can answer those questions honestly and openly, and that doesn't necessarily mean the first answer is going to be the right one
sentences.zh: 我想如果你能诚实、坦率地回答这些问题，而且这并不意味着第一个答案就是正确的，

sentences.en: because it might not be, but if you can write it down on a sheet of paper and think about maybe when you're walking the dog out on a run,
sentences.zh: 因为它可能不是，但如果你能把它写在纸上，在遛狗或跑步时思考一下，

sentences.en: all of a sudden it hits you between the eyes, that's the right answer.
sentences.zh: 突然间它就会让你眼前一亮，那就是正确的答案。

sentences.en: And that's what I talk to clients about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我和客户谈论的内容。

sentences.en: If you can get really clear on those four or five things, the next step after that is fairly logical.
sentences.zh: 如果你能真正理清那四五件事，接下来的步骤就相当合乎逻辑了。

sentences.en: You can just kind of drop things into place.
sentences.zh: 你可以顺理成章地把事情安排好。

sentences.en: But in terms of fixing your finances for 2024, complete a budget plan.
sentences.zh: 但就2024年的财务规划而言，请完成一份预算计划。

sentences.en: I know what you've got coming in, going out, put your money to work, make your money work in terms of getting money on your money
sentences.zh: 清楚自己的收入和支出，让钱为你工作，通过钱生钱的方式，

sentences.en: in terms of compound growth that we've talked about.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们谈到的复利增长。

sentences.en: By understanding what you've got coming in and going out, you can give everything a job.
sentences.zh: 通过了解你的收支情况，你可以给每一分钱分配任务。

sentences.en: You can understand what that's going to do for you.
sentences.zh: 你可以明白这些钱能为你带来什么。

sentences.en: Link that to those five bits that we've just talked about there.
sentences.zh: 把这些与我们刚才谈到的那五点联系起来。

sentences.en: And don't be afraid to make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 不要害怕犯错。

sentences.en: You don't have to have a rigid plan.
sentences.zh: 你不必制定死板的计划。

sentences.en: You don't have to stick to 100% every single day of the week, every single month, because you'll be miserable.
sentences.zh: 你不必每天、每个月都百分之百地执行，因为那样你会很痛苦。

sentences.en: Give yourself a little treat every now and again.
sentences.zh: 偶尔给自己一点小奖励。

sentences.en: Have a little bit of a blowout.
sentences.zh: 稍微挥霍一下也没关系。

sentences.en: Come back to it, reset the clock, start again.
sentences.zh: 然后再回来，重置时钟，重新开始。

sentences.en: If it fails once, come back and nail it again.
sentences.zh: 如果失败了一次，回来再战。

sentences.en: If it fails two times, come back and do it again.
sentences.zh: 如果失败了两次，回来再做一次。

sentences.en: You can start again tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 你明天就可以重新开始。

sentences.en: It doesn't make a difference if you don't quite get it this month, but just constantly keep that wheel moving forward.
sentences.zh: 这个月没完全做到也没关系，只要保持那个轮子不断向前转动就行。

sentences.en: Even just a little bit, celebrate the little wins.
sentences.zh: 哪怕只是一点点，也要庆祝小小的胜利。

sentences.en: Like 10 of a month, great, you've started.
sentences.zh: 比如一个月存了10块钱，太棒了，你已经开始了。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 了不起。

sentences.en: I could just keep going.
sentences.zh: 我还能一直说下去。

sentences.en: There's loads of tips I could give.
sentences.zh: 我能给的建议还有很多。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: Maybe we need to do that for another one.
sentences.zh: 也许我们需要再做一期节目。

sentences.en: It's such good advice.
sentences.zh: 这些建议太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for giving your time so freely.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你如此慷慨地分享你的时间。

sentences.en: So there we have it.
sentences.zh: 好了，就是这样。

sentences.zh: 一定要去领英上关注可爱的Ian。

sentences.en: He has great social posts over there, and I often get myself into some very interesting conversations, but he really gets me thinking.
sentences.zh: 他在那里发布了很棒的社交动态，我经常会参与一些非常有趣的对话，他真的让我受益匪浅。

sentences.en: Obviously, do get in contact with Ian if you wanted to look at engaging his services for your financial planning.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你想聘请他的财务规划服务，一定要联系Ian。

sentences.en: You know, you can learn a lot simply by following him and being in his world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，仅仅通过关注他并进入他的世界，你就能学到很多东西。

sentences.zh: 那么，你还有什么希望我涵盖的未来特别专题吗？

sentences.zh: 因为这一期节目就是这样产生的。

sentences.en: Do come and let me know.
sentences.zh: 一定要来告诉我。

sentences.en: Follow me over on any social channel.
sentences.zh: 在任何社交频道上关注我。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我到处都叫Dr. Marianne Trent。

sentences.en: If you're watching on YouTube, please do like and subscribe.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，请点赞并订阅。

sentences.en: Maybe tell your friends about us as well.
sentences.zh: 也许也可以告诉你的朋友们。

sentences.en: And there will be a QR code on screen that will take you to all of my social channels.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上会有一个二维码，可以带你进入我所有的社交频道。

sentences.en: If you're listening to this as an audio, please do just type in Dr. Marianne Trent to any of your social channels and I shall appear.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在听音频，请在你的任何社交频道输入Dr. Marianne Trent，我就会出现。

sentences.en: You can also come and connect with me over in the aspiring psychologist community with Dr.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在“有抱负的心理学家社区”（Aspiring Psychologist community）与我联系，

sentences.en: Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是Dr. Marianne Trent。

sentences.en: And yeah, if you do value this content, please do consider making a donation.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你确实觉得这些内容有价值，请考虑捐赠。

sentences.en: And there are details for that in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 节目说明里有相关的详细信息。

sentences.en: You might also find the books, the Clinical Psychologist Collective and the Aspiring Psychologist
sentences.zh: 你可能还会发现《临床心理学家集体》（The Clinical Psychologist Collective）和《有抱负的心理学家集体》（The Aspiring Psychologist Collective）这两本书很有帮助。
